Name: SHOWER
Description:
We are SHOWER – Structured Heat exchanger for Optimized Water Energy Recovery.  As a small team of engineers from TU Dortmund University, our mission is to reduce both the environmental impact and the cost of showering – without compromising on comfort.
   
In Germany, hot water generation consumes around 100 TWh of energy annually, making showering the second-largest source of energy use in private households. This leads to approximately 25 million tons of CO2 emissions each year – even though the warm water disappears down the drain within seconds.
   
With our patented technology standard looking shower trays  become heat exchangers that recover energy from wastewater to preheat the fresh, cold water. This allows households to reduce hot water costs by up to 200 € per person per year – without additional cleaning effort or regular maintenance. At the same time, it helps to significantly lower emissions.
   
We are currently preparing to launch our company and are working to bring our prototype into home bathrooms. Our project is supported by the European Union and the state of North Rhine-Westphalia through the EFRE program, as well as by a greenhouse.ruhr fellowship.

Name: Innovative Heat Exchanger Solutions
Description:
A patented geometric optimization for fin-and-tube heat exchangers enabling significant efficiency gains, reduced material usage, and improved system performance - without requiring new materials or manufacturing technologies.

Our solution introduces a targeted offset-fin geometry for heat exchangers used in heat pumps, HVAC, and industrial applications. Instead of increasing airflow (and energy consumption), the design improves heat transfer directly at the air-side inlet - where it is most effective.

This leads to a fundamental shift in performance behavior: higher heat transfer efficiency with minimal increase in fan power, reduced pressure drop, and improved overall system performance.

The concept enables new degrees of freedom in heat exchanger design, allowing manufacturers to optimize performance, energy consumption, material usage, noise emissions, and system size - while remaining fully compatible with existing production processes.

Key benefits include:
• Up to +20% heat transfer performance
• Reduced pressure drop and fan energy
• ≥25% reduction in tube material
• ~14% reduction in fin material
• Lower noise and more compact systems

At system level, this translates into substantial savings: heat pumps can reduce annual energy consumption by over 1,000 kWh, while HVAC systems achieve several hundred kWh savings. Additional system savings of 3–8% are possible.

The geometry also improves performance under frosting conditions, delaying ice formation and maintaining airflow stability under cold operation.

Developed at Technische Universität Ilmenau and validated through CFD simulations (ANSYS Fluent) and experimental testing.

Applicable to heat pumps, air conditioning systems, and industrial heat exchangers.

• CO2-freie Gebäudeheizung

Neben Energieeffizienz erhöht die dezentrale Architektur auch die Resilienz digitaler Infrastruktur, da viele kleine Einheiten weniger anfällig für Ausfälle sind als zentrale Rechenzentren. greenHeat wurde in Würzburg gegründet und entwickelt eine Plattform für dezentrale, nachhaltige und resiliente Computing-Infrastruktur.

Backed by Stripe, Shopify, and top climate investors, InPlanet helps companies the world over achieve net zero by removing CO2 at gigaton scale.

 Empowering Farmers, Restoring Ecosystems By applying finely ground silicate rock to tropical farmlands, farmers capture and store CO2 while improving soil health, boosting crop yields, and reducing reliance on chemical fertilizers. This regenerative approach enhances soil fertility, water retention, and nutrient availability, making farms more resilient to climate change. InPlanet supports farmers ensuring they benefit economically and environmentally while driving global carbon removal efforts.

 A Science-Backed, Scalable Solution Enhanced Rock Weathering is a natural process where silicate rocks react with CO2, forming stable bicarbonates that store carbon for millennia. By applying rock powders to farmland, InPlanet accelerates this process, delivering verified carbon removal, healthier soils, and more sustainable agriculture.

Name: Circular Carbon
Description:
We de-carbonize industrial processes for companies & municipalities. We use Biomass Waste to generate renewable energy and valuable biochar products.

500 years ago native Indians in the Amazon region built the foundation of an entire society on a magical and fertile soil - Terra Preta - in which biochar was the key ingredient. 

It improves agricultural productivity, particularly in low-fertility and degraded soils where it can be transformational for marginalized farmers; it reduces losses of nutrients, enhances growth of microorganisms and improves water-retention capacity of soils. 

Use of biochar has been identified as one of the most promising strategies to remove CO2 and CO2 equivalents from the atmosphere while being a source of renewable energy (heat from syngas). 

Biochar is produced from waste resources that many companies currently do not utilize. 

It has a unique capacity to enable ecosystem transformations, allowing businesses to transition towards a circular economy while improving their financial performance.

• Significantly lower operating costs

• Less maintenance and downtime

We utilize the significant cold energy released during the gas liquefaction process, which is then released upon regasification. Our technology prevents the waste of cold generated during the regasification process, making it usable. As a result, we can reduce emissions associated with cooling by 99.9%. We provide this cooling to clients across various industries such as food, manufacturing, chemicals, and more, enabling them to operate processes like production, storage, logistics, and building climate control with reduced emissions and costs for refrigeration, freezing, and air conditioning.

Description:
CyFract develops next-generation particle separation systems for sustainable water treatment in desalination and industrial reuse.

This enables energy-efficient and chemical-free water treatment that reduces OPEX costs by up to 50 percent while lowering environmental impact and improving operational reliability. 

This disruptive innovation builds on decades of research in flow optimization, advanced computational fluid dynamics simulations, and precision 3D printing that together enable unprecedented control of hydrodynamic separation at industrial scale.

Backed by SPRIND’s multimillion-euro innovation funding and supported by UnternehmerTUM, the Creative Destruction Lab, and the Deep Tech Alliance, CyFract is advancing from proven prototypes to large-scale containerized pilot units designed to purify up to 10,000 cubic meters of water per day.

Name: Visioverdis 2.0
Description:
Visioverdis develops "green products and processes" for the urban living space. The focus lies on the symbiosis of plants and technology. The botanical potential in itself is immense and can offer many new solutions to problems, especially in combination with technology and digitalization. In addition to our own research and development, consulting and contract research complement our range of services. Thanks to these complementary services, we are inspired by new ideas and collaborating to set future trends every day.

The main product of Visioverdis is the GraviPlant, an intelligent facade greening system for urban living space. Based on the integrated measurement of the plant biosphere, it enables the ideal nutrient supply for the plant and thus, ensures a vital, long-lasting greenery. The shape and characteristics of the plants also change due to a slow rotation, making them grow horizontally. With this innovation it is now possible, for the first time, to create a multi-layered facade greening system with all the associated advantages: air filtration, building cooling, noise reduction, green space and healthier environments.

Visioverdis is also working on projects in vertical farming. Please contact us for more information: info@visioverdis.de

Name: Aeroseal Europe
Description:
Aeroseal is a climate tech company on a mission -- reduce the world's carbon emissions by 1 gigaton annually. How will we do it? With our leak sealing technologies. 

Small leaks are a BIG problem. The ducts and walls in buildings are inadequately sealed by manual solutions.

Aeroseal’s technologies - HomeSeal Connect and AeroBarrier Connect - inject a fog of sealant particles into these pressurized spaces. Software tracks the entire process, creating a certificate of completion showing before and after leakage.

Aeroseal is one of the fastest-growing clean technology companies in the U.S. and currently has a presence in 27 countries and all 50 states across the U.S. Our technology has sealed nearly 200,000 projects and saved nearly $2 billion in wasted energy.
